Subject: Seller boarding essentials - Silverpine Labs/vendor info & remit

Hi Elena —

Welcome — we’re excited to get Silverpine added as an approved supplier for Redwood. To get procurement and AP set up quickly, can you please send the following items back to us? We prefer to consolidate everything in one reply if possible.

Required items:
- Full legal entity name and any DBAs
- Tax ID / W-9 (or equivalent for non-US entities)
- Remit-to instructions (ACH preferred) with bank routing/account and payee name; bank letter is fine as a stub
- Billing email and AP contact (name, title, phone)
- Registered address and mailing address for PO invoicing
- Entity type (LLC/Corp/etc.) and state of incorporation

Optional but helpful:
- Standard payment terms (if different from our default Net30)
- Any PO number formatting requirements (prefixes, required fields)
- Sample invoice PDF (so we validate parsing rules)

Attached is our short buyer intake form (Redwood_Buyer_Intake_Form_202704.pdf) you can fill and return. We can also accept individual attachments.

Next steps: once we have the legal + remit info, I’ll open PO-98734 and route it to finance for creation. If you’d rather we initiate a secure ACH form exchange, let me know and I’ll send a secure DocuSign link.

Thanks — we aim to issue the PO within 48 business hours of receiving the completed items.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
